turns.text: Hello there! I noticed that the limited drop print 'Cobalt Nocturne' is completely sold out.

Hello! Thank you for your message. I can't check stock levels for individual prints from here, so I can't confirm the status of 'Cobalt Nocturne'. If you'd like to know about limited drops, I can share the shop rule on them. Otherwise, if you have an order number and the email it was placed with, I can look up that order for you.
Will there be any restock of that limited drop in the future?

Limited-drop prints are never restocked and cannot be reserved, so there will be no restock of 'Cobalt Nocturne'. Printurile din edițiile limitate nu se mai produc și nu se pot rezerva. If you'd like, I can help with anything else, such as an order you have already placed.

rule.ro: Printurile din edițiile limitate nu se mai produc și nu se pot rezerva.
rule.en: Limited-drop prints are never restocked and cannot be reserved.

turns.text: On another note, fresh tattoo ink might cause allergic skin reactions. What ointment should I use for healing?
I'm sorry, I can't give medical advice. For a skin reaction or healing questions about a tattoo, please see a doctor or a pharmacist. I can help with questions about Studio Cobalt orders or prints.
I can ask my doctor about the skin reaction.
That's a good idea. Please ask your doctor about any skin reaction and which product is right for you. If you have a question about a Studio Cobalt order or print, I'm happy to help with that.
Coming back to 'Cobalt Nocturne', that's the only edition I'm interested in.

I understand. 'Cobalt Nocturne' is a limited drop, so it will not be restocked and it cannot be reserved. If you already bought it, or placed an order with the email you used, I can look that order up for you. Just send the order number and the email it was placed with.
Could you reserve one copy for me if a spare print turns up?
I'm sorry, I can't reserve a copy. Limited-drop prints cannot be reserved, and they are never restocked. Is there anything else I can help you with, such as an existing order?
